build_to.study_cross_check_note: SHURIKEN_STUDY.md 2.2's cross-check (50 mm tip, 10 mm arm, 22 mm hub, 35 deg = 3055 mm2, 60.0 g) is 0.51% low: the exact analytic area of that outline is 3070.60 mm2 (60.26 g). See area_check. The measured plate area is lower again because the 0.75 mm ground facets remove material over the taper; the measured mass is the correctness check against the ~60 g target.

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD0.note: study 4 LOD0: full outline, bevel, hole ring

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD1.note: study 4 LOD1: hole ring and bevel segments halved; roof past the bevel apex in 1 interval (hand-set: the derived 896 sat 4 under the ceiling)

SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD2.note: study 4 LOD2: bevel and hole dropped

lod1_is_distinct.note: LODs are authored by the radial-star generator at reduced segment counts (study 4's table), not decimated, so LOD1 is a genuinely different mesh: its hole ring and bevel segments are halved. max_surface_deviation_mm is two-sided (vertices, edge midpoints and triangle centroids of each mesh against the other's surface); the rev2 metric (LOD0 vertices only) is kept for comparison with rev 2's 1e-6 mm.

symmetry.method: max nearest-neighbour distance after a 360/8 deg rotation of the stored (float32) vertices. Quarter-turn forms are exact (0.0); any other n is exact in topology and float64 authoring, and lands within float32 storage precision (a few nm) on the stored mesh

known_gaps: LOD UVs are independent Smart UV unwraps of each authored LOD, not LOD0's UVs carried down (rev 2's Decimate carried them, distorted at folds). Nothing ships a texture yet - M_Shuriken_Master is procedural in object space and the FBX carries only Principled scalars - so nothing is visible today, but a baked or UV-tiled texture would change layout at each LOD switch. Before the pack-atlas bake, LOD1/LOD2 UVs must be made consistent with LOD0: either analytic UVs emitted by the generator per face class, or a per-face-class transfer from LOD0's islands.

No texture bake yet. The wear and grind are procedural and Cycles-only: they carry the renders, and the FBX exports only the Principled scalars, so nothing about them reaches the engine. The per-form wear radii travel as object custom properties (shuriken_wear_from / _to), which the FBX does not export (use_custom_props off).

The imported material slot binds to WorldGridMaterial when the verification import runs with import_materials=False. The slot NAME (M_Shuriken_Master) survives the FBX, so slot-based assignment works; whether the pack ships a UE material asset is a listing decision, not a mesh defect.

LightMapResolution is left at Unreal's default 64 for a ~10 cm prop, and the generated UV1 has never been exercised because the validation project sets r.AllowStaticLighting=False. Dropping it to 16 or 32 belongs to the Unreal-side import settings.

LOD0 UV coverage is 32.2% of the square. On the four-point, sweeping the packer over 20 shape x margin combinations moved it only between 26.0% and 32.0%, so the packer is not the limit - Smart UV Project's island shapes are. Hand-laying the shells belongs to the pack-atlas pass.

Tip angle (35 deg) and arm width (10 mm) are study 2.2 modelling defaults chosen to reproduce the ~60 g mass (study 2: no source publishes a tip angle); reference image A (Happo.JPG) was never downloaded, so the outline has not been checked against a photograph.
XXVIM.21, the best-measured eight-point, is only a mass reference: its trident points and rim hole are deliberately not reproduced. The shipped outline is the study's plain-point happo-gata.
LOD1 was hand-set (roof past the bevel apex in 1 interval instead of study_lod_chain's 2) to get a 49% step and margin under the 900 ceiling; see lod_choice.
LOD2 has no hole by design (study 4), so its two-sided deviation is dominated by the filled 9.5 mm hole; quote the arm-region figure for silhouette loss.

The UCX hull is the 16-vertex tip prism (hull='tip_prism'), not the pipeline's decimated hull (the pipeline hull, probed on this build: 24 verts, 1.118770882 mm off C8, LOD0 up to 0.300021 mm outside it). The prism is a flat 2.5 mm slab through the 8 tips: like any convex hull it spans the gaps between the points, and it stays full thickness over the ground facets, where the steel thins to the 1.0 mm chisel edge at each point (up to 0.75 mm proud per face at the tip). That is the conservative side for a thrown projectile; a stick-into-wall mechanic should trace from a tip (study 4), not rely on this hull.

area_check.method: Exact plan area of the un-bevelled outline = hub disc - round hole + 8 x (parallel run outside the hub circle + taper triangle). Parallel run = w * x_taper - cap, cap = integral over |y| <= w/2 of sqrt(r^2 - y^2) = (w/2) sqrt(r^2 - w^2/4) + r^2 asin(w / 2r). Taper triangle = (w/2) * L, L = (w/2) / tan(tip/2). shuriken_lib.spec.analytic_area; mass = area x 2.5 mm x 7.85 g/cm3.

study_slip.explanation: 3055 is 3055.33 mm2 rounded: the area you get when each arm's parallel run is counted as a plain rectangle from the line x = r_hub (10 x (34.142 - 22)) instead of from the hub arc. The arm root actually starts on the arc at x = sqrt(22^2 - 5^2) = 21.424 mm, so 8 circular slivers of 1.9089 mm2 (15.27 mm2 in all) belong to the star and were dropped.
study_slip.same_slip_in_study_2_1: The same formula on the four-point numbers gives 1668.42 mm2 exact (the study's corrected 1668) and 1647.42 mm2 when the arms are counted from the hub radius (the study's original 1647, 1.3% low).

area_check.which_is_right: The exact analytic area, 3070.60 mm2 (60.26 g at 2.5 mm), is the correct area of the outline study 2.2 specifies: an independent shoelace integration of the outline agrees to 1.5e-07 mm2, and the generator's own un-bevelled mesh at LOD0's counts matches the polygonised figure to 2.9e-06 mm2. The study's 3055 mm2 / 60.0 g is 15.60 mm2 (0.51%) low - the same arm-root slip as 2.1's first figure. The measured mesh (3041.57 mm2, 59.69 g) is right for the shipped asset and is lower than the exact outline because the ground bevel removes 27.40 mm2-equivalent and polygonisation 1.63 mm2. That the measured mesh lands near the study's number is a coincidence of two unrelated deficits, not a confirmation of the study's arithmetic.

physics.source: SHURIKEN_STUDY.md 4, Physics: set an explicit Mass in KG override (0.06 kg eight-point)
physics.note: Unreal would otherwise derive mass from the UCX hull volume, and the hull is a disc that spans the gaps between the points; hull_volume_mass_kg shows how far off that would be. Not written into the FBX (Unreal takes Mass in KG from the Body Setup, not the file).

originality.points: 8 plain single points, 35 deg included - deliberately NOT the three-tipped trident points of Royal Armouries XXVIM.21, which is a mass reference only
originality.hole: round centre hole, 9.5 mm minimum opening (study 2.2: the sourced retail typical) - not XXVIM.21's small hole near the rim beside an engraved dragon's head; no engraving
originality.tip_taper: 35 deg included, ground over the last 15.9 mm, ending in a 1.00 mm chisel edge
originality.finish: blackened oxide, not flat grey: base colour (0.035, 0.034, 0.033) linear with bare steel worn through on the points and the ground bevels - the coating loss on the points is the wear XXVIM.21 records (study 2.2)
originality.stamp: none (study 5; any future mark must be an invented glyph)
originality.franchise_strings: none in any object, mesh, material, texture or file name; qa_check no_franchise_strings passed on 3 of 3 objects

lod_choice.lod0: 2 columns, 2 notch, 2 hole segments per wedge (16-gon hole bridged 3:1 to a 48-segment hub), 3 bevel segments, 2 straight, 2 taper, 2 tip intervals
lod_choice.lod1: study_lod_chain (hole ring 16 -> 8, bevel 3 -> 2 segments, 1 straight, 1 taper interval) with the roof past the bevel apex in 1 interval instead of 2
lod_choice.lod1_reason: the derived LOD1 sat 4 triangles under its 900 ceiling and saved only 40%; the roof past the apex is 2.49 mm long, ~2 px at screen size 0.5
lod_choice.lod2: study_lod_chain: no bevel, no hole, 1 column, 1 notch segment per half notch (2 columns / 2 notch would be 320 triangles, over the 250 ceiling at C8)

rev3_changes: Not a change list: SM_Shuriken_EightPoint is revision 1. It was born on shuriken_lib 3.1.0 (the library rev 3 built for the pack), so from its first build it has what rev 3 gave the four-point: parametric LODs authored by the C_n generator (no Decimate), an exactly C8 mesh by construction, the shared M_Shuriken_Master with per-object wear radii, and the shared render rig.
LODs [1504, 736, 192] triangles; LOD1 differs from LOD0 by 0.298305 mm two-sided: 0.298305 mm inside the hub (8-gon hole ring) and 0.26289 mm on the arms (2-segment facet).

Library 3.1 (added for this form): spec.analytic_area, spec.numeric_outline_area and measure.unbevelled_plate_area_mm2 (area_check); geometry.author_tip_prism_hull behind a new opt-in RadialStarSpec.hull field (default 'pipeline'); pack.build_form now records hull_method. The four-point keeps the pipeline hull and its outputs are unchanged: LOD meshes, hull, socket matrices and FBX content bitwise identical, sidecar byte-identical (WorkFiles/shuriken/regression/regression_pack_eight.json).
fixes_applied: Inherited by construction, not re-fixed: every rev-2 four-point lesson is in the library - the plate and ground bevel are authored (no bmesh.ops.bevel clamping), every vertex goes through the 1 nm orbit-keyed factory and the hygiene gate refuses zero-length edges, zero-area faces and coincident vertices before an object exists (measured here: 0 / 0 / 0).
Centre hole: circumscribed 16-gon, 9.500 mm across the flats (the true minimum opening), as the four-point.
Bevel: 0.75 mm requested, 0.75 mm measured on the finished mesh.
LOD screen sizes 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.25 travel in the .sockets.json sidecar (pipeline.export_fbx) and are applied by ue_import_sockets after import.
Sockets are Empties through the sidecar (FBX sockets land at scale 100); the hull keys to the LOD0 node name (UCX_SM_Shuriken_EightPoint_LOD0_00).

engine_check.note: Pointer, not a claim about the file you are holding: re-run both passes after any change to the mesh or the sidecar; pass 2 in a fresh process is the gate (ASSET_GUIDELINES 6.5). UnrealCheck4's pass scripts are form-parameterised (SHURIKEN_FORM env var) and read the mesh name, FBX, sidecar and Blender LOD counts from <form>_report.json. last_pass2 is read from disk at build time; matches_this_build compares its triangle counts with this build.
engine_check.content_check: The FBX Unreal imported is kept in verified/. FBX bytes change every export (header timestamp, object UIDs), so WorkFiles/shuriken/regression/compare_pack_eight.py re-imports the verified copy and the current export and compares vertices, triangles and the sidecar bytes (final_export_vs_unreal_verified).
